title: How to open another page instead of Role Center when launching Business Central (Automatically skip the Role Center page)
summary: This post explains how to bypass the Role Center and open a different page automatically when users launch Business Central. It covers the limitations of Role Centers (no triggers allowed), demonstrates using the OnRoleCenterOpen event from Conf./Personalization Mgt. codeunit, and provides a code example that opens the Sales Order List instead of the default Role Center.
key_points: Role Center pages cannot have triggers or respond to OnOpenPageEvent
The OnRoleCenterOpen event in codeunit 9170 allows code execution after Role Center opens
Users can navigate directly via URL as a workaround, but this fails for Windows and mobile apps
Performance may suffer if Role Center has heavy content; minimize or leave it empty for best results

quotes.text: A page of type Role Center cannot have triggers.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core constraint that prevents direct Role Center manipulation and necessitates alternative approaches like event subscribers

quotes.text: codeunit 9170 "Conf./Personalization Mgt." -> OnRoleCenterOpen(): Although it cannot completely replace Role Center, you can perform some processing immediately after opening Role Center.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the only viable event-based solution for executing code at Role Center startup to achieve the page redirect goal
